payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped the structured diagnostics snapshot data model. New canonical `DiagnosticsSnapshot` type in @fricken/protocol (schema identity + compatibility verdict, subscriptions, cursors, pending appends, recent acks, redacted error envelopes, connection state, cache metadata, sync timing, capabilities/limits) plus redactDiagnosticsContext + DIAGNOSTICS_VERSION. Server-side assembleDiagnosticsSnapshot(store, opts) builds it from a live FrickStore: migration compatibility, idempotency cache metadata, requested stream-cursor probes, and recent error envelopes from the DevTools feed (every envelope redacted of secrets). Gateway-only surfaces passed via runtime. Tests: packages/protocol/tests/diagnostics.test.ts + apps/server/tests/diagnostics-snapshot.test.ts (incl. secret-redaction). Branch feat/fr76-77-diagnostics-cli.
